subject.title: fix(ui): prevent collapsed sidebar overlap in control UI

question: Should the 96px collapsed rail apply only to desktop layouts, or is the tablet drawer-mode rail also allowed to widen?
rationale: The PR changes a root CSS token shared by desktop and tablet collapsed navigation, and that responsive behavior is a UX/compatibility choice that green tests alone cannot settle.

options.title: Scope the wider rail to desktop
options.body: Keep the 96px value only where the shell reserves a desktop grid column, while preserving the existing tablet drawer-mode rail unless separately changed with proof.

options.title: Accept shared rail width with proof
options.body: Allow the wider token to affect tablet drawer mode if the PR adds clear responsive proof that tablet content and drawer behavior remain usable.

options.title: Replace the stale branch
options.body: Close or supersede this branch with a fresh narrow PR if rebasing the old test path and proofing the responsive behavior is no longer worth it.

recommendation.title: Scope the wider rail to desktop
recommendation.body: Keep the 96px value only where the shell reserves a desktop grid column, while preserving the existing tablet drawer-mode rail unless separately changed with proof.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev authored the core dashboard shell and mobile drawer layout work that defines the affected responsive contract.
